headlines.title: PM vs. MO: The Smoke-Free Dividend Winner in This Tobacco Showdown
headlines.summary: Philip Morris and Altria both just raised their dividends, but the gap between them runs far deeper than yield percentages and payout sizes. Which tobacco giant actually deserves a spot in a retirement portfolio built to last a decade?

headlines.title: 3 Reasons Growth Investors Will Love Philip Morris (PM)
headlines.summary: Philip Morris (PM) could produce exceptional returns because of its solid growth attributes.

headlines.title: Trump administration plans to speed approvals of vapes and nicotine pouches - WSJ
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- The Trump administration is preparing a major regulatory shift to accelerate market authorization for smoke-free nicotine products, according to reporting by The Wall Street Journal. The Food and Drug Administration is expected to announce changes easing the requirements of its 2021 premarket review framework in coming days, establishing a streamlined regulatory pathway for alternative nicotine delivery systems.

headlines.title: Philip Morris International (PM) Lifts Quarterly Dividend 8.8% To $6.40 Annualized
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International (NYSE: PM) announced a significant increase in its regular quarterly dividend on 21 September 2026. The revised payout applies to the upcoming dividend cycle, affecting shareholders of record as of the next declared date. Management described the higher dividend as aligned with the board's view of the business's cash generation and financial position.

headlines.title: This High-Yield Tobacco Stock Just Raised Its Dividend by 8.8%
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International raised its quarterly dividend by 8.8% to $1.60 per share, lifting the annual payout to $6.40 after smoke-free products accounted for about 42% of sales.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
